decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed side and rear extensions, because of their design, bulk and scale in such a highly prominent corner location, will be out of character with the streetscene, unbalancing the existing three storey terrace from the front and side and thus detrimental to the character of the streetscene, contrary to policies IMP 1.4, ENV-B 1.1 and H 6.4 of the Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines 

2.	The density, scale and layout of the development proposed would lead to unacceptable loss of amenity to existing residents, through loss of outlook and unacceptable amenity to proposed residents through noise and disturbance and inadequate amenity space, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1 and H 4.1 of the Unitary Development Plan 
3.	The proposed increased use of No 146 for new residential, retail and office use would lead to an excessive development of this limited corner site, resulting in increased noise and disturbance to existing and proposed residential and commercial users in the area, contrary to policies IMP 1.4, ENV-B 1.1 and H 4.1 of the Unitary Development Plan.
4.	The creation of 2 new shops on Mayfield Avenue would be out of character with the residential nature of the street, resulting in increased noise and disturbance to residents through the introduction of commercial uses, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1 and IMP 2.4 of the Unitary Development Plan 
5.	The proposed development would not be fully accessible to people with impaired mobility, resulting in the creation of a non inclusive environment, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.8, E 3.1, S 4.2 and S.4.4 of the Unitary Development Plan  
6.	The proposed loss of servicing area and increased use of the site would result in and create unacceptable impacts on the local parking provision and access for existing premises and emergency vehicles along the rear alleyway, and servicing, refuse and recycling collection, for the proposed users, contrary to policy T1.4 of the Unitary Developme
description: Erection of a four storey side and rear extension incorporating enlargement of basement creating a self contained office in the basement, single storey rear extension to create 2 new retail units with basement and ground floor, and new shopfronts, and direct access onto Mayfield Avenue, to erect two storey structure at rear, to be used as additional self contained office space. To use the extended upper floors as 2 x 2 bed flats, and the extended roof space as 1 x 1 bed flat
